results.title: [PDF] National Human Development Report - Colombia at a Crossroad
results.content: Opportunities: Possible trajectories for human development in Colombia | 209 In this final chapter, in particular, the analysis, based on the concept of human productivity, has focused on the actions that could contri-bute to the convergence of the development trajectories of the territories, based on the con-sideration of three elements: i) a different way of conceiving and addressing public affairs; ii) the deepening of the principles set out in the national Constitution to strengthen and recognize the country’s multicultural and mul-tiethnic richness and to consolidate the social contract based on bonds of trust; and iii) the increase in labor productivity through relevant education and its connection with the market. Opportunities: Possible trajectories for human development in Colombia | 211 Finally, territorial entities, ethnic groups, and their own governance structures, as well as the state’s reach, must be strengthened to ensure the enabling conditions that allow men and women to achieve greater productive, politi-cal, physical, and social inclusion, thereby pro-moting environmentally sustainable human development 212 | National Human Development Report 2024 Bibliography Lora, E.
